{{short description|Hungarian mathematician}}
[[File:Peter P. Palfy Oberwolfach 2011.jpg|thumb|Palfy at [[Mathematisches Forschungsinstitut Oberwolfach|Oberwolfach]] in 2011]]
'''Péter Pál Pálfy''' (Debrecen, 23 August 1955) is a Hungarian mathematician, working in algebra, more precisely in group theory and universal algebra. Between 2006 and 2018 he served as the director of the [[Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics]].<ref>{{Cite web|title = Rényi – The History of the Institute|url = https://renyi.hu/en/the-institute/az-intezet-tortenete|website = renyi.hu|access-date = 2023-04-01}}</ref>

== Career ==
Pálfy graduated from [[Eötvös Loránd University|Eötvös University]], Budapest in 1978 and started working at the [[Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics]]. He was deputy director of the Institute from 1991 to 1997. From 2000 to 2005 he had a full-time professorship at Eötvös University. In 2006, he returned to the [[Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics]] as director<ref name=cv>{{cite web|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170203165436/https://www.renyi.hu/~ppp/cveng.pdf|url=https://www.renyi.hu/~ppp/cveng.pdf|archive-date=2017-02-03|url-status=dead|title=Curriculum vitae}}</ref> holding this position until 2018 as well as a part-time professorship at Eötvös University.

Pálfy obtained his DSc degree in 1997.<ref name=cv/>  He was elected a corresponding member of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences in 2004 and full member in 2010.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mta.hu/koztestuleti_tagok?PersonId=19355|title=Pálfy Péter Pál|publisher=Hungarian Academy of Sciences|access-date = 2025-05-23}}</ref>
